uploads.title: Taiwan’s Silicon Shield: The $5 Trillion War Deterrent #Shorts

learnings: Hook viewers within the first 1.5 seconds with a high-stakes question or startling stat.
Include concrete numbers and high-impact terms in titles (e.g., '$5 Trillion', 'War Deterrent').
Keep Short scripts under 45 seconds to maximize completion rate and potential replay loops.
Frame geopolitical topics around clear conflicts, hidden economic costs, or global disruption.
Script seamless end-to-beginning loops for Shorts to boost watch time percentage.
Test long-form deep-dives (8-12 minutes) alongside Shorts to build strong subscriber affinity.
double_down: The Secret Undersea Cables Carrying 99% of Global Data
Why the U.S. Cobalt Monopoly Failed Overnight
The Chokepoint Controlling the World's Food Supply
avoid: Drawing definitive strategy conclusions from a single video with 2 views.
Slow, traditional documentary introductions that delay the main thesis.
Generic historical recaps without a modern high-stakes angle.
Overly dense technical jargon that distracts from the core narrative arc.
